website.label: Website
website.summary: The production website and key public routes were reachable during the 2 August check. A release candidate fixes the Wikimedia image policy and light-theme contrast and passes the complete local pre-deploy gate.

content.label: Published content
content.summary: The governed public content snapshot contains 182 published records and was regenerated on 1 August 2026. The map combines 167 coordinate-backed records with all 342 official municipalities.

ios.label: iOS public distribution
ios.summary: Apple's public lookup service reports App Store version 1.2. Version 1.3 (build 8) was locally built, signed, uploaded and submitted to App Review on 2 August 2026; it is not yet the public store version.

businessForm.label: Business and feedback forms
businessForm.summary: Secure Supabase endpoints and Admin review views are active. The latest read-only check confirmed expected server-side validation without creating a production record.

limitations: Endpoint reachability and invalid-input rejection were verified without creating a synthetic inquiry or feedback record.
